description: Popup for inserting a status chip, with a label input, a live styled preview, a color-swatch selector, and an Insert button, raising OnInserted with the label and color.

parameters.name: InitialColor
parameters.description: Initial color used when opening the picker.

parameters.name: InitialLabel
parameters.description: Initial label used when opening the picker for an existing chip.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: Fixed left position in CSS pixels.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the user dismisses the picker.

parameters.name: OnInserted
parameters.description: Raised when the user confirms a non-empty status label.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: Fixed top position in CSS pixels.
